description: Rebuilt from the Identity Wing's lat_ordered_chain, which could not fire per identity: its three steps are three different identities (an account, a program, a file). Here they are one person's set, in order, at most 60 minutes apart: (1) a sign-in - interactive_logon (Security 4624 logon types 2, 10 Remote Desktop, 11); (2) a remote-administration tool runs - program_run (Prefetch, no account) or process_created (Security 4688, the account that started it); (3) an executable lands in the Windows system area - file_created (USN journal bursts; files there carry no account). Network sign-ins (logon type 3) have no UBA rule, so a chain that starts with one is not found: that gap is recorded in the default_wings README.
proves: A person signed in, a remote-administration tool ran, and an executable was dropped into the Windows folder, in that order
author: Crow-Eye Team

steps.label: Executable created in the Windows system area
